Author: Vipin Chandra Dixit
Bench: Vipin Chandra Dixit
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 92
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 7265 of 2023
Applicant :- Ajeet Shahi

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Rajiv Lochan Shukla,Ashutosh Kumar Shukla
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Mohd. Shoeb Khan Hon'ble Vipin Chandra Dixit,J.
Heard Sri Rajiv Lochan Shukla, learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State, Sri Mohd. Shoeb Khan, learned counsel for the informant and perused the record.
It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present case.
The first information report was lodged after about 18 years by means of application which has been filed under Section 156(3) Cr.P.C..
It is alleged in the first information report that illicit relationship was developed by the applicant 18 years ago and a son namely Armaan was also born, who is 17 years old.

It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that the husband of the victim was working in the house of applicant and there was some dispute between the husband and wife and since, the applicant has supported the husband of the victim, he has been falsely implicated in this case.

It is further submitted that the applicant has applied for D.N.A. test and his blood sample was preserved on 10.01.2023 but in spite of repeated notice, the victim could not appear along with her son Arman for giving sample of blood of her son for D.N.A. test.
Learned counsel for the applicant has explained his criminal history in para 38 of the affidavit filed along with bail application.

There is no possibility of fleeing away from the judicial Ajeet Shahi vs State Of U.P. on 21 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/34859773/
1 process or tampering with the witnesses and in case, the applicant is enlarged on bail, the applicant shall not misuse the liberty of bail.

entities.text: judicial Ajeet Shahi vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The applicant is in jail since 23.11.2022.
Learned A.G.A. for the State and learned counsel for the informant have vehemently opposed the prayer of bail.
However, they do not dispute the aforesaid facts.

Considering the submissions of learned counsel for the parties, from perusal of the record and considering the complicity of accused, severity of punishment as well as totality of facts and circumstances, at this stage, without commenting on the merits of the case, I find it a fit case for bail.
The bail application is allowed.

Let the applicant Ajeet Shahi be released on bail in Case Crime No. 245 of 2022, under Sections 376,
506 I.P.C., registered at Police Station Turkpatti, District Kushinagar, on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Court concerned, subject to the following conditions:
(i) The applicant will not tamper with prosecution evidence and will not harm or harass the victim / complainant in any manner whatsoever.
(ii) The applicant will abide by the orders of the court, will attend the court on every date and will not delay the disposal of trial in any manner whatsoever.
(iii) The applicant will not indulge in any unlawful activity.
(iv) The applicant will not misuse the liberty of bail in any manner whatsoever.

The identity, status and residential proof of sureties will be verified by the court concerned and in case of breach of any of the conditions mentioned above, court concerned will be at liberty to cancel the bail and send the applicant to prison.
